```{r}
#| include: false
# Deck front matter, read once. Each deck is listed only if its rendered HTML
# is committed next to it, since that file is what the site serves. A deck can
# set `site-title:` in its front matter to be listed under a different name
# from its title slide (Lecture 1's title slide just says "Biometry").
deck_title <- function(f) {
  fm <- rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter(f)
  if (!is.null(fm[["site-title"]])) fm[["site-title"]] else fm$title
}

deck_info <- function(dir, pattern) {
  qmd <- list.files(file.path("..", dir), pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  qmd <- qmd[file.exists(sub("\\.qmd$", ".html", qmd))]
  data.frame(
    base  = sub("\\.qmd$", "", basename(qmd)),
    title = vapply(qmd, deck_title, ""),
    row.names = NULL
  )
}

lectures <- deck_info("lectures", "^Lecture_\\d+_.*\\.qmd$")
lectures$num <- as.integer(sub("^Lecture_(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", lectures$base))
lectures$solutions <- grepl("solution", lectures$base)

supplements <- deck_info("supplements", "^\\d+_.*\\.qmd$")
```

Slides and supporting material for Biometry at the University of South Florida,
taught by Dr. Brian Maitner. The course follows Ben Bolker's *Ecological Models
and Data in R* (Princeton University Press, 2008).

Every deck opens in the browser and works offline once loaded. Use the arrow
keys to move through the slides and `F` for full screen.

## Lectures

```{r}
#| output: asis
link <- function(text, href) sprintf("[%s](%s)", text, href)

rows <- vapply(sort(unique(lectures$num)), function(n) {
  these <- lectures[lectures$num == n, ]
  main  <- these[!these$solutions, ]
  sols  <- these[these$solutions, ]
  sprintf("| %d | %s | %s |", n,
          paste(link(main$title, paste0("lectures/", main$base, ".html")),
                collapse = "<br>"),
          paste(link(rep("Solutions", nrow(sols)),
                     paste0("lectures/", sols$base, ".html")),
                collapse = "<br>"))
}, "")

cat("| # | Lecture | Exercise solutions |",
    "|--:|:--------|:-------------------|",
    rows, sep = "\n")
```

## Supplements

Optional material beyond the course, written to work without a lecturer in the
room. Each one comes as a page to read and as slides.

```{r}
#| output: asis
rows <- sprintf("| %s | %s | %s |",
                supplements$title,
                link("Read", paste0("supplements/", supplements$base, ".html")),
                link("Slides", paste0("supplements/", supplements$base,
                                      "-slides.html")))

cat("| Supplement | | |",
    "|:-----------|:--|:--|",
    rows, sep = "\n")
```
